_about: Copy and reading paths for the welcome at the top of / (app/welcome.tsx) and the heading of the summary carousel under it. Edit freely; no code change needed.
_source: intro and paths: COPY s-d7, linkedin-content/local/site-copy/welcome.md (18:50), pasted as written. Keep Alex's ' -- ' as it is (no em dashes).
_paths: Each path is a list of site paths in reading order. Titles, one-liners and minutes come from content/inventory.json at build time; an item that's missing there or not live is left out (a /#post-<id> missing from the inventory falls back to content/feed.json, text only). '/for/<your-slug>' is the visitor's own page: it renders as a chooser of the six pages in intro.your_page and counts intro.your_page.min.
